document.about: Federal Reserve Monetary Policy Report, June 2025. Page 29 sets Figures 20 and 21 side by side, each chart in a panel drawn round it with its title set in the panel's head.

notes: 2026-11-26 (#398): the two charts' titles were read line by line across the pair, so Figure 20's second line, `consumption expenditures`, came after Figure 21's title.
